title: Heavy Spiked Club

fields.Availability: Can be recovered by disarming Buthir or Lump. Humanoids cannot equip it.
fields.Base value: 20 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Tenacity: In the main hand, a missed melee attack can spend a Reaction to deal Bludgeoning damage equal to Strength modifier, minimum 1.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
